description: A lone samurai walks through rain-soaked neon Tokyo streets at night, dolly shot from behind.

spec.subject: A lone adult samurai of average height and lean build, wearing a dark indigo kimono under a black lacquered chest armor, wide hakama trousers, and a rain-darkened straw kasa hat; a wrapped katana hangs at the left hip, the fabric edges soaked and heavy with rain.
spec.setting: Nighttime Tokyo side street in heavy rain, lined with bright neon signs, vending machines, and wet asphalt reflecting magenta, cyan, and red light; foreground filled with puddles and splashing footsteps, midground the samurai and storefront shutters, background stacked vertical signs, power lines, and blurred apartment windows disappearing into rain haze.
spec.action: The samurai walks steadily forward through the rain, shoulders slightly hunched against the weather, with water streaming off the hat brim and armor.
spec.camera_angle: Behind the subject, eye level, medium-wide shot on a 35mm lens, the samurai centered slightly low in frame with the street leading away ahead.
spec.camera_movement: slow dolly forward, maintaining a fixed distance behind the subject
spec.lighting: Motivated by neon signage and storefront practicals from both sides of the street, with a cool cyan key from camera-left and a magenta-red rim from camera-right; soft overall contrast from rain diffusion, bright specular reflections on the wet pavement, light atmospheric haze in the air.
spec.style: Digital capture with fine grain, 2.39:1 aspect ratio, saturated neon color grade with deep blacks and reflective highlights, in the vein of Blade Runner 2049 with wet street reflections and dense colored practicals.

description: A gunslinger's eyes in extreme close-up as a church bell rings over a dusty square at noon.

spec.subject: A weathered male gunslinger, late 30s to early 40s, with sun-cracked skin, short stubble, and a scar cutting through one eyebrow; only both eyes and the bridge of his nose are visible in frame, with a dusty film on his eyelashes and a faint reflection of the square in his pupils.
spec.setting: Dusty frontier town square at noon, dry heat and bright sun, with pale adobe storefronts and a low church tower implied beyond the frame; foreground is the gunslinger’s face filling the image, midground is the sun-bleached square, and background is the church bell tower ringing over drifting dust.
spec.action: He holds perfectly still, eyes narrowing slightly as he listens to the bell ring.
spec.camera_angle: front, eye level, extreme close-up, 135mm macro look, the eyes centered slightly low in frame with the bridge of the nose cutting up from the bottom edge.
spec.lighting: Hard overhead noon sunlight motivated by the open sky, with a sharp top-light catching the moisture line in the eyes and a bright dust-filled bounce from the square below; high contrast, warm sunlit highlights with pale beige and ochre shadows, no visible practicals, light airborne dust in the air.
spec.style: Digital capture with fine grain, 2.39:1 aspect ratio, slightly desaturated western color grade with sun-bleached highlights and warm earth tones, in the vein of Sergio Leone’s close-up tension but with a cleaner, modern sensor texture and crisp eye detail.

description: Two sisters argue in a cramped Seoul apartment kitchen, handheld, fluorescent light.

spec.subject: Two Korean sisters in their late 20s and early 30s, both average height and slim build, wearing everyday indoor clothes: one in a gray sweatshirt and loose black pants with her hair tied back in a messy bun, the other in a white T-shirt under a faded blue cardigan with shoulder-length straight hair; both tense, faces tight, one clutching a dish towel, the other with one hand braced on the counter
spec.setting: A cramped Seoul apartment kitchen at night, narrow galley layout with laminate cabinets, a small stainless sink, rice cooker, dish rack, chopping board, and a cluttered counter; foreground dominated by the edge of the table and a hanging dish towel, midground by the sisters and sink, background by tiled wall, upper cabinets, and a frosted window with the city faintly visible beyond
spec.action: The sisters argue face-to-face, one leaning forward and pointing toward the counter while the other recoils and answers sharply
spec.camera_angle: three-quarter front view, eye level, medium shot, 35mm lens, both sisters crowded slightly off-center with the nearer sister on the left third and the other on the right third
spec.camera_movement: handheld, slight jitter with a subtle push-in
spec.lighting: overhead fluorescent kitchen light as the key, centered above them and spilling forward, creating flat cool-white illumination with mild shadows under brows and chins; practical under-cabinet reflections on metal surfaces; no warm sources, slight green cast typical of fluorescent tubes, no haze
spec.style: digital, naturalistic handheld realism, fine grain, 16:9, cool green-white color grade, in the vein of Hong Sang-soo with observational framing and unadorned apartment detail
